free_coefficients.h_meaning: h = c_12, the Laurent coefficient of (z - z0)^9; the normalised datum is eta = h/a0
free_coefficients.statement: Pure-power class, K = 6 even, n = 3, p = 3, Fuchs index k0 = 12. Let w be a solution meromorphic in C and z_i a pole, with leading coefficient a0 (Eq(-D*a0**2, 20160)) and free coefficient h = c_12. Then gamma_{a0}(h) = 0, where gamma_{a0} = gamma_{a0,10} is a polynomial of degree exactly 2 in h with a leading coefficient that does not depend on the coefficients of Psi; moreover gamma_{a0,j}(h) = 0 for every j >= 1 and gamma_{a0,0}(h) takes the same value at all poles of w. Hence at most 2 values of h per a0, at most 4 Laurent series and at most 4 poles modulo the periods.
